wprl.source: Blockscout ERC-20 Transfer events from/to 0x0 (mints/burns), reconciled to totalSupply()

price.source: api.prlscan.com/v1/market/prl/history (Pearl OTC VWAP → SafeTrade close → CoinMarketCap)

launch_week.note: Launch week (Apr 27 to May 3): 41,203 blocks, 125.1M PRL, 39% of all PRL issued to date. 13,934 blocks on day one at difficulty 1. All solo coinbase, 6,698 addresses, no pools. Widely spread: top address 3.1%, top 10 10.5%, top 100 30.8%, 200 addresses hold half. 3,385 addresses won one block; 14 won 100+. 99.9% still unspent. Left off the bars; kept in the table.

venue_arrivals_note: Value arriving at the labelled venue addresses per week (SafeTrade hot wallet external inflow, Pearl OTC escrow settlements, bridge deposits), split into miner-origin (backward pro-rata origin fraction) and all sources. SafeTrade arrivals are lumpy because the exchange sweeps deposit addresses in batches (nothing reaches the labelled hot wallet in weeks 10-19); use weekly.first_spend for the timing of the miner decision.
miner_balance_note: Balance = all unspent PRL on the 72,379 miner addresses at week end (UTC Monday). balance_miner_origin excludes PRL those addresses received from non-mining sources. sold_to_balance = PRL sold that week (SafeTrade + Pearl OTC, by miner spend time) / balance at end of prior week.
